theme.title: Beyond the Box Score
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: As a player, Larry Bird led the 1985–86 Celtics to 67 wins. How many did his 1997–98 Pacers win in his first year as coach?
questions.note: 58, and Bird was named Coach of the Year in his first season on the bench.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 58–24 record

funFacts.text: Larry Bird became Indiana's coach before this season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hired former Indiana State University, and Boston Celtics All-Star legend Larry Bird as their new head coach

funFacts.text: The Pacers acquired Chris Mullin from Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired All-Star forward Chris Mullin from the Golden State Warriors

funFacts.text: Indiana drafted Providence forward Austin Croshere twelfth overall.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: received the twelfth overall pick in the 1997 NBA draft

questions.prompt: Game 5 of the 1984 Finals at Boston Garden had no air conditioning. How hot was it inside, in °F?
questions.note: 97 °F, hot enough that a referee fainted and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was given oxygen.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: as it was played under 97 °F (36 °C) heat, and without any air conditioning

funFacts.text: An oxygen tank was brought out for Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in sweltering Boston Garden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: an oxygen tank was provided to give air to an aging Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

funFacts.text: Referee Hugh Evans became dehydrated and was replaced after fainting in the first half.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Referee Hugh Evans became dehydrated and fainted at one point in the first half.

funFacts.text: Boston's players even skipped their usual sweatpants during pregame warmups.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics did not warm up with their sweat pants on because of extreme heat

questions.prompt: Bars: other guards' 40-point playoff nights. How many did Jalen Brunson score at Philadelphia in April 2024 for a Knicks playoff record?
questions.note: 47 with 10 assists, passing Bernard King's 46 from 1984 for the Knicks' playoff record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jalen Brunson scored 47 points, setting a Knicks franchise playoff record en route to securing a commanding 3–1 series lead back to New York.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Brunson shot 18-of-34 from the field

funFacts.text: He recorded 10 assists to only one turnover.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finished with an assist-turnover ratio of 10 to 1

funFacts.text: Brunson surpassed Bernard King's Knicks postseason mark.
